overview: Malaysia is a country in South-East Asia, made up of the southern part of the Malay Peninsula and the north of the island of Borneo. Its capital and largest city is Kuala Lumpur, home of the Petronas Towers. Malaysia became independent from the United Kingdom in 1957. It is a federation with an unusual monarchy: its king is chosen in turn from the rulers of nine states.

geography.text: Malaysia is split in two by the South China Sea. Peninsular Malaysia has mountains down the middle and coastal plains where most people live. On Borneo, the states of Sabah and Sarawak are covered in rainforest and include Mount Kinabalu, one of the highest mountains in South-East Asia. Malaysia's rainforests are among the oldest in the world.
